history.overview: The Outer Ring forms the first line of defense around the Muramite Citadel.

timeline.name: Rampart Construction
timeline.description: Muramite forces built fortified ramparts and gatehouses.

timeline.name: Siege Deployment
timeline.description: Siege engines were deployed along the Outer Ring.

timeline.name: Discord Reinforcement
timeline.description: Discord energy reinforced the ramparts and siege platforms.

timeline.name: Resistance Sabotage Attempts
timeline.description: Resistance agents attempted sabotage of siege equipment.
